title: 2027 Admissions to Tsinghua Shenzhen International Graduate School
institution: Tsinghua Shenzhen International Graduate School (SIGS), Tsinghua University
about: Tsinghua Shenzhen International Graduate School is accepting international applications for 2027 entry to its master's and doctoral programmes (40 master's, 22 doctoral). Applications go through Tsinghua's international portal; the general deadline is 15 May 2027, 17:00 Beijing time. Some programmes close earlier.
requirements: Bachelor's or master's degree obtained before the 2027 registration date
English proficiency for non-native speakers (e.g. IELTS 6.5 or TOEFL iBT 85, per the admissions page)
card_alt: EduCut Connect card for 2027 Admissions to Tsinghua Shenzhen International Graduate School at Tsinghua Shenzhen International Graduate School (SIGS), Tsinghua University, Shenzhen, China, deadline 15 May 2027. The photo shows the painted gate with red lanterns of Shuhe Ancient Town in Lijiang, Yunnan, not Shenzhen.
